versions.subject: Merge PR #4838 from @frack113 - Add `Access To Windows Outlook Mail Files By Uncommon Application`
versions.detection:
selection_unistore:
    FileName|contains: '\AppData\Local\Comms\Unistore\data'
selection_unistoredb:
    FileName|endswith: '\AppData\Local\Comms\UnistoreDB\store.vol'
filter_main_system:
    Image: 'System'
filter_main_generic:
    # This filter is added to avoid large amount of FP with 3rd party software. You should remove this in favour of specific filter per-application
    Image|contains:
        - ':\Program Files (x86)\'
        - ':\Program Files\'
        - ':\Windows\system32\'
        - ':\Windows\SysWOW64\'
filter_optional_defender:
    Image|contains: ':\ProgramData\Microsoft\Windows Defender\'
    Image|endswith:
        - '\MpCopyAccelerator.exe'
        - '\MsMpEng.exe'
filter_optional_thor:
    Image|endswith:
        - '\thor64.exe'
        - '\thor.exe'
condition: 1 of selection_* and not 1 of filter_main_* and not 1 of filter_optional_*
versions.spl: FileName IN ("*\\AppData\\Local\\Comms\\Unistore\\data*", "*\\AppData\\Local\\Comms\\UnistoreDB\\store.vol") NOT (Image="System" OR Image IN ("*:\\Program Files (x86)\\*", "*:\\Program Files\\*", "*:\\Windows\\system32\\*", "*:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\*")) NOT ((Image="*:\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\Windows Defender\\*" Image IN ("*\\MpCopyAccelerator.exe", "*\\MsMpEng.exe")) OR Image IN ("*\\thor64.exe", "*\\thor.exe"))
